'''''Lagerstroemia subcostata''''', the '''Taiwan crepe myrtle''', is a [[deciduous]] tree native to Japan, the [[Ryukyu Islands]], [[Taiwan]], and southern China, and introduced to the Philippines.<ref name="POWO_553622-1" >{{cite POWO |id=553622-1 |title=''Lagerstroemia subcostata'' Koehne |access-date=15 June 2024 }}</ref>

When ''L. subcostata'' var. ''fauriei'' is crossed with ''[[Lagerstroemia indica]]'', the result is ''[[Lagerstroemia × egolfii]]'' (usually given as ''Lagerstroemia indica'' × ''fauriei''), the hybrid crape myrtle, which has many cultivars and is widely planted as an ornamental in the United States.<ref name="_DMV_crew_2022" >{{cite journal |title=A new nothospecies in ''Lagerstroemia'' (Lythraceae) |date=2022 |last1=Whittemore |first1=Alan T. |last2=Schori |first2=Melanie |journal=Phytotaxa |volume=539 |issue=3 |pages=294–300 |doi=10.11646/phytotaxa.539.3.10 }}</ref><ref name="Certified_Plant_Nerd1" >{{cite web |url=https://landscapeplants.oregonstate.edu/plants/lagerstroemia-hybrid |title=''Lagerstroemia'' (hybrid) |last1=Breen |first1=Patrick |date=2024 |website=Landscape Plants |publisher=Oregon State University |access-date=15 June 2024 }}</ref><ref name="POWO_77296122-1" >{{cite POWO |id=77296122-1 |title=''Lagerstroemia × egolfii'' Whittem. & Schori |access-date=15 June 2024 }}</ref><ref name="Certified_Plant_Nerd2" >{{cite web |url=https://landscapeplants.oregonstate.edu/plants/lagerstroemia-fauriei |title=''Lagerstroemia fauriei'' |last1=Breen |first1=Patrick |date=2024 |website=Landscape Plants |publisher=Oregon State University |access-date=15 June 2024 }}</ref>
